For 30 staff in Hyderabad, I’d shortlist:

SreeFoods Corporate Catering — Madhapur; specifically positioned for corporate catering. Good if your office is around HITEC City/Gachibowli.

Craft My Plate - Main Office — Gachibowli; useful for recurring office meals and meal-box formats.

Elite Caterers — central Hyderabad; established caterer with strong reviews.

Budget: For recurring lunch, roughly ₹150–₹250/person/day is a sensible starting target. yumEATS lists ongoing corporate lunch boxes at ₹190 and daily lunch packages at ₹120, while broader corporate catering can run ₹250–₹450+.
